sources.title: GitHub - wassname/query-steering: modify the model attention so it can ...
sources.snippet: A model can know something about its situation and not say it: that it is being tested, or what it did earlier in an agent run. Steering the queries made it read that back (Demos 2 and 3), without training and from generic pairs. Here the model was told it is an eval; whether this works when the model only infers it is still open.

sources.title: wassname (Michael J Clark) - GitHub
sources.snippet: Query steering We wanted to try steering a model's attention. It works! We steer its attention towards a secret, and it blabs about it. This could help with eval awareness, and with checking what a model knows when chain-of-thought monitoring is fragile.
